bugs.rootCause: The Issues-screen 'New task' wizard create+run path persists and dispatches a remote-only repo pick (`owner/repo`) verbatim as `repo_ref`, skipping the clone-resolution step that the Boards path performs. In crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/rpc/mod.rs, `board_card_create` (L2600-2624) runs the picked repo_ref through `resolve_card_repo_ref` (L2648), which clones a remote-only favorite via `ainb_fleet_core::repo_clone::ensure_clone` into `<hangar_home>/clones/<dir>` and persists the resulting LOCAL path. The wizard path does NOT: `handle_issue_update` (L1437 trims, L1472 `CardParityRepo::set_issue_repo_agent`) writes the raw remote id, and `handle_issue_run` (L2817 `run_override`, L2820 `run_card`) forwards the raw remote id as the run override. The plugin (fire_issue_dispatch, crates/ainb-plugin-hangar/src/plugin.rs L2676) legitimately passes the picked repo_ref straight through both `issue_update` and `issue_run` with the SAME raw values, so both daemon handlers receive an unresolved remote. Downstream `provision_worktree` (crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/workdir_provision.rs) treats repo_ref as a literal filesystem Path; `stevengonsalvez/agents-in-a-box` resolves to no directory, so `resolve_start_point`'s `git -C <bogus-path> rev-parse` fails on both candidates and emits the misleading 'source branch `main` not found' error. No clone/worktree is ever created (clones/ dir absent, worktrees/ empty). The real defect is 'repo never cloned', not a missing branch.
bugs.fixPlan: Mirror the Boards resolution in both wizard handlers, reusing the existing idempotent `resolve_card_repo_ref` (path/`scratch` pass through unchanged, remote clones once). (1) In `handle_issue_update` (rpc/mod.rs ~L1437-1478): when `repo_ref` is Some, resolve it via `resolve_card_repo_ref(&hangar_home()?, r)` before `set_issue_repo_agent`, exactly as board_card_create does at L2605-2612, so the persisted card holds a LOCAL path. (2) In `handle_issue_run` (~L2817): resolve `run_override` through `resolve_card_repo_ref` before passing to `run_card` (idempotent, so a pre-resolved path from step 1 or the board path double-passes harmlessly). Add daemon tests paralleling `resolve_card_repo_ref_clones_remote_only_favorite` (L5631) that drive `handle_issue_update` + `handle_issue_run` with a remote-only repo_ref and assert the persisted repo_ref / run override is the cloned local path, not the raw `owner/repo`. Note: repo-picker-impl/validate agents are already active on this exact area — coordinate to avoid a duplicate fix.

bugs.rootCause: After the dispatched task errored in the daemon, it never transitioned to a terminal `failed` state: the daemon log shows two identical ERROR lines ~100s apart with a sweeper reclaim between them, attempt count stayed at 1, and `agent_task_queue.status` stayed `dispatched` across ~2.5 min. Because the run never terminalizes as failed, the Board and task-detail screens (cycle-1/v3-17-board-reentry.txt, v3-18-card-detail.txt) surface zero error indication — the card sits under Todo and detail reads 'Runs: 1 (last: queued)' despite two hard execution errors. This is a distinct defect from the repo_ref clone bug: even once repo_ref resolution is fixed, any run that errors deep in provisioning would loop dispatched/error/sweeper-reclaim invisibly rather than marking the task failed and showing it on the board. Likely lives in the sweeper/reclaim + task terminalization logic in crates/ainb-hangar-daemon (task execution error handling should set a terminal failed status and emit an event the board/detail screens render).

bugs.rootCause: A pre-start setup fault (provision, prepare_env) in execute_claimed returns Err via `?` (crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/run_loop.rs ~line 660) BEFORE the dispatched->running transition. The claim loop's only handling is tracing::error!("task execution errored") (run_loop.rs:393); the row stays 'dispatched'. The terminal-failure path (finalize_failed -> attempt increment + failure_reason + TaskFinished(Failure) + auto_move_after_terminal + maybe_spawn_retry) only runs after the provider actually runs, so a pre-running fault never reaches it. reclaim_stale_dispatched (crates/ainb-hangar-daemon/src/sweeper.rs:226) then redelivers the row to 'queued' every reclaim_window (~90s) with a FRESH dispatched_at and attempt UNCHANGED, so it never ages past dispatched_ttl for sweep_stale_dispatched's fail_batch and never consumes max_attempts. Task 01KY1WWXNVCE5P1Y99VA71V752 stayed status=dispatched, attempt=1 (max_attempts=2), failure_reason NULL across 3 cycles ~90s apart; card HGR-1 sat in Todo with no badge (v3_daemon_log_full.txt, v3_10_final_board_state.txt). The run_loop.rs:~623 comment claiming the sweeper will 'reclaim + re-queue' a provision fault is the defect: reclaim is for lost claims, not deterministic setup faults.
bugs.fixPlan: Make a pre-start setup fault terminal instead of a silent 'dispatched'. In execute_claimed, wrap the pre-running setup (resolve_dispatch already falls back; guard prepare_env and workdir_provision::provision) so on error it finalizes the claimed/dispatched row through the fail service as an infra/setup failure: set a failure_reason (e.g. 'setup_failed: <err>'), increment attempt, then call maybe_spawn_retry so the F06 chain retries within max_attempts and, on exhaustion, lands the row terminal 'failed' (dispatched->failed is already a valid edge that fail_batch uses). Also emit TaskFinished(Failure) + auto_move_after_terminal so the card leaves Todo and shows the failure in the TUI, and teardown the just-provisioned worktree if any. Do NOT return the bare Err to the claim loop for pre-start faults. Add a behavioral test: a provision that errors (bad/unclonable repo_ref) drives the task to attempt=max_attempts and status='failed' with a non-NULL failure_reason within N sweeps, and the card auto-moves to a failed column — proving no infinite reclaim loop. Update the stale run_loop.rs:~623 comment to reflect that setup faults finalize, not reclaim.
